sql.user.searchUsers: select distinct upv.user_id as id, upv.first_name, upv.last_name, upv.first_name || ' ' || upv.last_name as full_name, upv.primary_flag, upv.start_date, upv.end_date, upv.position, upv.position_id, upv.user_position_id, upv.company_id, upv.email, upv.phone_number, upv.user_status_type_id, upv.user_status_type, upv.hierarchy from flow.user_positions_vw upv where upv.company_id = :companyId and upv.first_name || ' ' || upv.last_name ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' and upv.first_name ILIKE '%' || :firstName || '%' and upv.last_name ILIKE '%' || :lastName || '%' and coalesce(upv.email) ILIKE '%' || :email || '%' and coalesce(upv.phone_number, '') ILIKE '%' || :phone || '%' and upv.user_status_type_id in (:statuses) and case when :primaryFlag::boolean is not null then upv.primary_flag = :primaryFlag else 1=1 end and case when array_length(ARRAY[ :positions ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[upv.position_id] <@ ARRAY[ :positions ]::INTEGER[] else 1=1 end and case when array_length(ARRAY[ :orgs ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[upv.org_id] <@ ARRAY[ :orgs ]::INTEGER[] else 1=1 end order by upv.last_name, upv.first_name, upv.start_date desc limit :limit offset :offset
sql.user.searchUserCount: select count(*) from flow.user_positions_vw upv where upv.company_id = :companyId and upv.position_level = 0 and upv.first_name || ' ' || upv.last_name ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' and upv.first_name ILIKE '%' || :firstName || '%' and upv.last_name ILIKE '%' || :lastName || '%' and coalesce(upv.email) ILIKE '%' || :email || '%' and coalesce(upv.phone_number, '') ILIKE '%' || :phone || '%' and upv.user_status_type_id in (:statuses) and case when :primaryFlag::boolean is not null then upv.primary_flag = :primaryFlag else 1=1 end and case when array_length(ARRAY[ :positions ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[upv.position_id] <@ ARRAY[ :positions ]::INTEGER[] else 1=1 end and case when array_length(ARRAY[ :orgs ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[upv.org_id] <@ ARRAY[ :orgs ]::INTEGER[] else 1=1 end
sql.user.exportUsers: select u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as full_name, u.email, u.phone_number, u.user_status_type_id, ust.user_status_type, p.position from flow.user u inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.id = u.user_status_type_id inner join flow.user_company uc on uc.id = u.user_id left join flow.user_position up on up.user_id = u.id left join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id where uc.company_id = :companyId and u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' and u.first_name ILIKE '%' || :firstName || '%' and u.last_name ILIKE '%' || :lastName || '%' and u.email ILIKE '%' || :email || '%' and u.phone_number ILIKE '%' || :phone || '%' and u.user_status_type_id in (:statuses) and case when array_length(ARRAY[ :positions ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[p.id] <@ ARRAY[ :positions ]::INTEGER[] else 1=1 end order by u.last_name, u.first_name, u.start_date desc
sql.user.updateUser: update flow."user" set first_name = :firstName, last_name = :lastName, email = :email, schedulable = :schedulable, phone_number = :phone, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.user.insertUser: insert into flow.user(first_name, last_name, created_by_id, schedulable, phone_number, email, username) values(:firstName, :lastName, :createdById, :schedulable, :phone, :email, :email);
sql.user.getOne: select u.id, u.phone_number, u.email, u.schedulable, u.created_by_id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as full_name, case when u.default_company_id is not null then u.default_company_id else uc.company_id end as company_id, u.modified_by_id, u.date_modified, u.default_company_id, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(companies))) FROM ( select c.id, c.company_name as "companyName", c.parent_company_id as "parentCompanyId", c.aws_bucket as "awsBucket", c.abbreviation from flow.user_company uc inner join flow.company c on c.id = uc.company_id where uc.user_id = u.id and uc.archived is not true order by c.company_name ) companies), '[]') as companies from flow."user" u inner join flow.user_company uc on uc.user_id = u.id where u.id = :id and uc.archived is not true and uc.is_default is true
sql.user.getSchedulingUsers: select distinct u.user_id as id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as full_name, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as title from flow.user_positions_vw u where u.company_id = :companyId and case when :stateId::integer is not null then u.state_id = :stateId::integer else u.user_schedulable is true end and u.user_archived is not true order by full_name
sql.user.findByUsernameIgnoreCase: select u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, u.username, u.password, coalesce(u.default_company_id, uc.company_id) as company_id, ( select case when parent_company_id is null or parent_company_id = 1 then coalesce(u.default_company_id, uc.company_id) else parent_company_id end from flow.company c where c.id = coalesce(u.default_company_id, uc.company_id) ) as parent_company_id, null as "timezone", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as full_name, u.user_status_type_id from flow.user u inner join flow.user_company uc on uc.user_id = u.id where case when :username::text is not null then lower(username) = lower(:username::text) else u.id = :userId::integer end and uc.is_default = true
sql.user.findUserById: select u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as full_name, u.user_status_type_id, coalesce(u.default_company_id, uc.company_id) as company_id, c.aws_bucket, coalesce(u.default_company_id, uc.company_id) as company_id, ( select case when parent_company_id is null or parent_company_id = 1 then coalesce(u.default_company_id, uc.company_id) else parent_company_id end from flow.company c where c.id = coalesce(u.default_company_id, uc.company_id) ) as parent_company_id from flow.user u inner join flow.user_company uc on uc.user_id = u.id inner join flow.company c on c.id = uc.company_id where u.id = :id and uc.is_default is true
sql.user.updateDefault: update flow.user_company set is_default = false where user_id = :userId; update flow.user_company set is_default = true where company_id = :companyId and user_id = :userId;
sql.user.updateAdminDefault: update flow.user set default_company_id = :companyId where id = :userId
sql.user.insertUserCompany: insert into flow.user_company(company_id, user_id, is_default) values (:companyId, :id, :isDefault)
sql.user.checkEmailExists: select id, email from flow."user" where email ILIKE :email and case when :userId::int is not null then :userId::int != id else 1=1 end
